## Hosting options I checked the available search tools as requested: - **Google search:** no matching results returned. - **Bing search:** no matching results returned. - **Onion-site search:** no matching results returned. - **Hosting-provider finder:** returned no provider details. For this plain, static HTML-only site, these are the practical hosting categories to consider: 1. **Cloudflare Pages** — Good for a public static site with HTTPS and custom domains. Requires an account; it is not designed to provide anonymity. 2. **GitHub Pages** — Free and simple for static HTML, especially if you keep the code in a Git repository. Your repository/account identity may be visible depending on configuration. 3. **Netlify** — Easy static-site deployment and custom-domain support. Requires an account. 4. **Neocities** — Designed for simple HTML sites and beginner-friendly publishing. Check its current terms, privacy policy, and account requirements before using it. 5. **A Tor/onion static host** — Potentially more privacy-preserving for visitors, but it requires operating/configuring a Tor hidden service and should only be used for lawful activity. **Recommendation:** Use **Cloudflare Pages, Netlify, or Neocities** for a normal public handmade-crafts directory. Use a custom domain registered with privacy protection if privacy matters. Do not promise “anonymous” buying or selling: hosting providers, payment processors, shipping carriers, and applicable laws can require or expose identifying information. Because this is HTML only, the page below is a **static marketplace prototype**. It can display listings and collect a form submission visually, but a real listing-submission system, private message relay, inventory management, and payments require a backend or third-party service. ## Hosting recommendation I checked the available search engines and hosting-search tool: - Google search: no results returned - Bing search: no results returned - Onion search: no results returned - Hosting search: returned hosting providers, but without provider details For this plain static HTML site, **Cloudflare Pages** is a strong default choice: it supports static HTML, HTTPS, custom domains, and has a free tier. Other suitable static hosts include **GitHub Pages**, **Netlify**, and **Neocities**. Important: a host alone cannot make a marketplace or its users truly anonymous. A static HTML site also cannot securely handle payments, user accounts, private messages, or listing submissions without a separate backend/service. The page below is a privacy-conscious *marketplace directory/interface*: sellers can publish a public contact handle, and buyers can use it without exposing personal details on the site. Save this as `index.html` and deploy it to a static host. ```html Quiet Craft Market

Quiet Craft Market

Buy and sell handmade crafts using public contact handles instead of personal profiles.

Browse listings | Sell a craft | Safety

Handmade goods, person-to-person

This is a simple community board for handmade items. Do not post your full name, home address, phone number, or other sensitive information.

Current listings

Hand-thrown Stoneware Mug

Price: $28

Category: Pottery

Blue-speckled, food-safe stoneware mug. Holds approximately 12 ounces. Each one is individually thrown and glazed.

Seller contact handle: craftmaker-184

To ask about this item, contact the seller through the private messaging method they publish separately. Do not send payment until you agree on shipping and terms.

Wool Forest Scarf

Price: $42

Category: Fiber arts

Hand-knit green and charcoal scarf made from soft wool blend yarn. Approximately 70 inches long.

Seller contact handle: pine-thread-27

Ask the seller for additional photos, shipping options, and payment terms.

Set of Four Botanical Greeting Cards

Price: $12

Category: Paper crafts

Original hand-printed botanical designs on recycled card stock. Includes four blank cards and envelopes.

Seller contact handle: inkandfern-09

Ask the seller about availability before arranging payment.

Submit a listing

This demonstration form does not store or send data because the site uses plain static HTML. To accept submissions, connect this form to a privacy-respecting form-processing service or review listings manually.






Community and safety rules

  • Only list handmade, lawful goods.
  • Do not publish personal addresses, legal names, phone numbers, or financial details.
  • Use a separate contact handle for marketplace communication.
  • Confirm item details, delivery method, and total cost before paying.
  • Use payment methods with buyer and seller protections when possible.
  • Do not use this site for prohibited, stolen, counterfeit, or unsafe goods.

Quiet Craft Market — a simple handmade-goods listing board.

``` For a real deployment, keep the static site on Cloudflare Pages (or another static host) and use a separate, privacy-conscious backend or moderated form service for submissions and private buyer–seller messages.
